covers: The OKI MSM6295 ADPCM sound chip as a chip

entries.name: OKI MSM6295 ADPCM
entries.description: Four-voice ADPCM sample player: it plays phrases from an external ROM, chosen by a number, at one of sixteen volumes.
entries.behaviour: One port. A write is a command byte and a read is the status of the four voices. A phrase number indexes a table of start and stop addresses at the head of the ROM.

handlers.set_pin7: pin 7 level: the sample rate is the clock over 132 when high and over 165 when low
